METADATA: FATE Model v2-1 - Integrated model for GHG emissions from forest fires in primary forests
Emissions from fires not associated with deforestation
Input spatial products: Mapbiomas Fire collection 2 (1986-2022), SEEG 10 forest mask stable, and Rectified QCN carbon stocks
Biophysical processes:  Combustion, tree mortality, tree regeneration and decomposition
Forest mask stable is the total standing forest at the end of the time series
Rectified QCN carbon stocks are maps corrected by Mapbiomas vegetation classes
amazonia-CO2_Tg_comb_read_warning-v2-1: Gross CO2 emissions from combustion
amazonia-CO2_Tg_balance-v2-1: Net CO2 emissions from combustion, decomposition and regeneration
